plugin.2110_io.audio_fmt_tip: Audio format announced by the received SDP
plugin.2110_io.disruptive_confirm: This operation will briefly cut ALL the engine's flows.
plugin.2110_io.flux_reader_missing_tip: Flow reader not loaded (io_flux.js): this value is unavailable, not zero.
plugin.2110_io.ident_overlay_tip: 3-line burn-in (name · source/multicast · format), black background, top right
plugin.2110_io.ident_size_tip: IDENT text size — drag ↕, wheel, arrows (Shift = coarse step). Enter = automatic size.
plugin.2110_io.label_empty: — the requested level is empty for this source
plugin.2110_io.label_inherited: — inherited from the video of the same Rx
plugin.2110_io.label_settable: · level can be set at the top of the page
plugin.2110_io.not_subscribed_tip: Slot not subscribed — no flow and no generator (empty output)
plugin.2110_io.port_auto_tip: Port (NIC) of this group — Auto = automatic distribution across the network ports
plugin.2110_io.port_pair_tip: 2022-7 pair (both legs) or port of this group
plugin.2110_io.q_cap_tip: Hot ceiling: {reserved} queues reserved at mtl_init — beyond that, a redeploy is required
plugin.2110_io.q_over: {active} live · +{pend} planned, of which {over} > reserved ({reserved}) → redeploy
plugin.2110_io.realign_tip: One or more sources are subscribed but receive no flow. Redeploying the engine realigns the queues (brief cut of ALL flows).
plugin.2110_io.sdp_activate_tip: Forces PATCH master_enable:true on the remote NMOS sender matching this SDP (hardware that does not enable itself)
plugin.2110_io.sdp_modal_hint: Active SDP received via NMOS. Paste/edit then “Apply” for an immediate manual subscription (without an external controller). “Unsubscribe” cuts the flow.
plugin.2110_io.sdp_present: An SDP is set on this slot
plugin.2110_io.st_inactive_tip: No subscription on this flow: nothing is requested from the source.
plugin.2110_io.st_mute_tip: Subscribed, but no sample is arriving: the source is silent or absent.
plugin.2110_io.st_noflux_tip: Subscribed (IS-05) but no flow is coming back: RX creation failed (node lcore budget) or no network traffic (source/switch).
plugin.2110_io.st_subscribed_tip: Subscribed, but no frame is coming back yet.
